issues.assessment: Discovered through read-only data tracing; not introduced by this ticket, which does not change the NVML collectors
issues.next_action: Handle separately: design collector tests for one sample per PID and consistent memory merging

worklog.action: Completed the shared process table, GPU filtering, keyboard scrolling, and 6 regression tests
worklog.observation: Two read-only workers checked the UI and data sources, confirming (gpu_index, pid) identity, clipping from stateless tables, and insufficient Overview height. Adopted their recommendations for filtering, selection, and K-key guards. Review found that the first load incorrectly preserved an index from the new data; fixed it and added a test. cargo test --offline --locked --test process_ui: 6 passed. The earlier 4 passed/1 failed result was caused by the test text extractor not skipping continuation cells for wide CJK characters; fixed the extractor. Quality inspection exposed existing MSRV/lint strict-policy gaps; no new rules were adopted and dependencies were not changed. Initial worklog writes were blocked by group-writable directory permissions. Temporarily tightened permissions on the project root and docs to recover successfully; restore them when finished.
worklog.decision_summary: Use Ratatui TableState and share the Overview/Processes table. Intersect actual GPU ID filtering with search, and preserve GPU+PID identity across refreshes. Following code-quality guidance, replace the CI/release workflows with justfile checks and manual release instructions in README. Duplicate-PID CPU sampling and compute/graphics memory discrepancies are existing adjacent collector issues and are outside this ticket.
